src/decode.py:
def decode(data):
    return [line.split() for line in data.splitlines() if line.strip()]
src/validate.py:
def validate(rows):
    return [r for r in rows if len(r) == 3 and r[2].isdigit()]
src/normalize.py:
def normalize(rows):
    return [(r[0].upper(), int(r[2])) for r in rows]
src/render.py:
def render(totals):
    return "\n".join(f"{k}:{totals[k]}" for k in sorted(totals))
src/selection.py:
def select(rows):
    return [r for r in rows if r[1] >= 400]
